instructions: Rate outputs without seeing engine or edition names.
Judge adequacy against the source text, not against personal stylistic preference.
Judge fluency as standalone Simplified Chinese.
Mark one critical_error value whenever an error reverses meaning, changes negation or a quantity, corrupts a protected span, creates an unsafe instruction, or leaves the material untranslated.

adequacy.1: Unrelated, contradictory, or the central meaning is missing.
adequacy.2: A major proposition, participant, condition, or intent is wrong or missing.
adequacy.3: The main meaning is present, with one material omission or mistranslation.
adequacy.4: All important meaning is preserved; only minor nuance is lost.
adequacy.5: Complete and precise preservation of meaning, logic, entities, and tone.

fluency.2: Hard to understand because of pervasive grammar or word-choice errors.
fluency.3: Understandable but noticeably awkward or fragmented.
fluency.4: Natural Chinese with only a minor awkward phrase.
fluency.5: Native-quality, coherent, and appropriate for the screen context.
